parent_experiment.status: DEVELOPMENT_QUALIFICATION_ONLY / V11 PROVIDER-TRANSPORT QUALIFIED BUT HARNESS QUALIFICATION FAILED
parent_experiment.relationship: V12 is a new post-V11 observability/classification treatment; the first-ten order, GPT-OSS 20B, high reasoning, prompt, controller, PatchManager, hidden-data boundary, budgets, and one-attempt policy are inherited unchanged.

qualification_boundary: Results cannot be promoted into an unseen benchmark capability score.
first_ten_order_policy: exact prefix of the immutable source full ordering; no resampling or reordering
treatment_changes_from_v9: metadata discovery has a separate 60-second deadline
generation has a fresh fixed 1080-second absolute maximum
streaming retains a fixed 45-second idle/progress timeout
outer provider process deadline is 1200 seconds per model request
the treatment explicitly supplies a 2400-second aggregate model/controller phase: two complete 60+1080 request envelopes plus 120 seconds controller margin
the overall worker task budget is fixed at 3600 seconds: 2400 model/controller-phase seconds plus two 360-second official evaluator windows and a fixed cleanup margin
official image inspection and pull are bounded separately and never rely on Docker implicit pull during evaluator execution
official evaluator stage evidence records image preparation, container/test execution, result collection, child wait, and cleanup observations
the pinned evaluator remains unmodified and the official verifier remains the sole correctness authority
no metadata-only preflight or readiness campaign exists in this treatment

V12 adds bounded official evaluator lifecycle evidence, report hashing before cleanup, typed public-runtime command evidence, and provider-response-bound classification; it does not alter correctness semantics or the V11 treatment budgets

evaluation.correctness_authority: official SWE-rebench independent verifier via OfficialSWERebenchVerifier
evaluation.model_workspace: base commit only; no test_patch; no gold patch
evaluation.verifier_workspace: base commit + hidden test_patch; gold never applied as model input
evaluation.hidden_data_boundary: intrinsic model task isolation; private bundle consulted only after candidate

harness.common_architectural_baseline_semantics: V6 frozen harness-content identity carried as a common baseline; it is not the immediate experiment parent
harness.identity_freeze_rule: This exact hash must be recorded only after the V12 treatment source is committed on its feature branch; the live guard rejects modified or non-ignored untracked relevant source.

provenance.v9_external_evidence: V9 is immutable incomplete evidence; task 4 is interrupted with no terminal classification and is never rerun.
provenance.v10_external_evidence: V10 is immutable invalid setup evidence: ten infrastructure-invalid rows, ten transport attempts, zero provider generation calls; it is never rerun.
provenance.qualification_observation: V11 has exactly one seen DEVQUAL-10 campaign; V12 is pre-live observability-only and no unseen pilot is authorized by this contract.

timeout_semantics.official_evaluator_timeout_semantics: pinned evaluator has no container/test timeout; stage evidence and the 360-second outer watchdog are safety bounds; 300 seconds is the semantic task reference
